arguments.question: Can we buy food contact items or gaskets from a supplier without a food-grade certificate?

content:
No, we cannot buy them from that supplier.

Under Rasoi's purchase policy (POL-PUR-001 §6.2 and POL-SUP-003 §4.1), parts that come into contact with food—including the 5-litre silicone gasket (GSK-SIL-05L)—may only be purchased from suppliers with a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. Even if their price is lower, the certificate must be uploaded and verified before any order can be placed.

arguments.question: food-grade certificate requirement for gaskets or food-contact items

content:
No, we cannot buy from them. Under Purchase Policy §6.2 (POL-PUR-001 §6.2) and Supplier Policy §4.1 (POL-SUP-003 §4.1), parts that touch food—explicitly including gaskets—may only be purchased from suppliers holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. 

Regardless of price, an accredited food-grade test certificate must be uploaded and verified in Bahi before we can place an order with any supplier for these items.
